_comment: Merge into <your-project>/.claude/settings.json. Paths assume the skill was copied to .claude/skills/figma-validate. These are project-level hooks, not SKILL.md frontmatter hooks: frontmatter hooks register only after the skill runs (too late to pre-flight its own invocation), and a frontmatter Stop hook is converted to SubagentStop.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null || { echo 'figma-validate needs node on PATH' >&2; exit 2; }; node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skills/figma-validate/hooks/preflight.mjs"
